name: The tool's start compiles only a tree not yet compiled
step: Check the tool's start skips the walk on a compiled tree
rationale: The configuration tool's start (src/rfsuite/ui/home.lua) runs the compile pass (src/rfsuite/lib/precompile.lua) only for a tree that is not the one last compiled, as the widgets do. This runs the tool's own start on the accounting stubs for a compiled tree, a new install, a changed tree, a developer's request for the whole walk, a developer's skip, and a pass that compiles thirty files while the start screen shows its count.
